messages.welcome_message: Welcome to the Mira Farmstead inn.
messages.price_message: Twelve coins for warm beds and a hot meal. Will you stay?
messages.stay_message: Sleep well. The party sleeps deep and dreamless.
messages.goodbye_message: Morning! HP and PP restored. Off you go.
messages.not_enough_coins: A warm bed is 12 coins. Come back when your purse agrees.
